summary: Blueberry lookout, Peace River area: a 1979 notice offered its 60 ft tower for removal; no build, staffing or current-site record found, and two Canada Lookouts pages disagree on location.

facts.design: Pole-legged tower with a plywood lookout building at the top

events.note: Notice dated 27 July 1979 invites offers to buy the tower 'as is and where is' for removal or demolition. No outcome is recorded.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Two Canada Lookouts pages share the name Blueberry. The Peace River page gives 56.721 and 121.765 at 846 m, which matches our record. The Kootenay-Boundary page gives 49.554 and 118.519 at 2,363 m but carries the Wonowan notice. No source read links the two pages, so the story keeps the Peace River record and says the location is unconfirmed.

sources.title: Blueberry (Kootenay-Boundary page, quoting a Prince George Citizen notice of 27 July 1979), Canada Lookouts

notes_for_editor: Only tower-specific sources are the two Canada Lookouts pages. The 1979 notice is quoted there from the Prince George Citizen; the newspaper itself was not read. The notice's Wonowan site is not located in any source read, so the link to the Peace River coordinates rests on the shared name and region. The spelling Wonowan is the page's; Wonowon is the usual modern form, unverified here. Next step: a BC Archives or Peace-area history search for the tower's build date and whether the 1979 sale led to removal. Facebook group threads were not readable and are not used.
